title: District thalassemia unit bank crosses 1,200 units in a single year
summary: A standing arrangement between eleven clubs and three hospitals turned an ad-hoc emergency network into a predictable monthly supply for paediatric thalassemia patients.

title: Solar microgrid brings evening study hours to a tribal ashram school
summary: A 9kW rooftop array with battery backup replaced a diesel generator that ran for two hours a night, unlocking a supervised evening study block for 210 residential students.

title: Four gram panchayats take over water ATMs after a two-year handover
summary: The interesting part is not the installation — it is that all four units are now maintained on panchayat budget lines, two years after the club stepped back.

title: Menstrual health curriculum reaches 38 municipal schools
summary: Co-designed with school counsellors and delivered by trained peer educators rather than visiting volunteers — a change that doubled session attendance.

title: A three-year mangrove restoration audit, published in full
summary: Survival rates, species performance and the sites that failed — all of it public. The first district project to publish negative results alongside the headline number.

title: Skill lab helps 140 women artisans move to direct online sales
summary: Photography, listing hygiene, pricing and GST basics — a six-week lab that ended with each artisan holding a live storefront and their first ten orders.

title: Sanitation blocks handed over at nine zilla parishad schools
summary: Built to a shared district specification with a named maintenance owner per site, following the model that fixed the Anganwadi programme's durability problem.

title: Two district Rotaractors selected for a peace fellowship exchange
summary: A twelve-week exchange focused on community mediation practice, with both fellows committing to run district-level training on return.

title: Cataract camp crosses 800 surgeries across three districts
summary: A pooled logistics model where four clubs share transport and post-op follow-up, cutting per-patient cost by a third against running the camps separately.

title: Library-in-a-box reaches its sixtieth village
summary: A rotating 300-book crate that moves between villages every quarter, tracked with a simple card system that villages run themselves.

title: Vocational programme places 46 hearing-impaired graduates
summary: Employer-side sensitisation turned out to matter more than candidate training — the placement rate tripled once the club started running sessions inside partner companies.

title: Flood relief network moves 22 tonnes in 96 hours
summary: A pre-agreed roster of drivers, warehouses and verification volunteers, activated by a single message — built during peacetime, tested in a crisis.
